text: Pass over any item that fails twice instead of stopping the batch. Two landed fixes already pass over an item that fails twice when the scope guard has paused or flagged it, but at 12:39pm UTC on 4 Nov a batch with $43 and 3 job slots left stopped again because the item (job 20261029-160024-80qj) had failed twice with no pause or flag. Remove the item-level repeated-failure stop: after an item's second failure, record it, leave it for the scope guard and Hestia, and run the next item. Keep the batch stops that are not about a single item (disk, login, settings, the kill switch). Acceptance: a test where an unflagged, unpaused item fails twice and the batch then runs the next item; the existing tests for the other stops still pass.
